name: agent-ops-patterns
description: Operational patterns for running LLM agents in production - and skills for assessing the ideas of Stanford CS329A against your repo or mapping a system's recurring judgments and validation gaps.

plugins.name: agent-ops-skills
plugins.description: Skills from agent-ops-patterns: assess the ideas of Stanford CS329A "Self-Improving AI Agents" against your repo (a disposition record with a quoted file:line or a scoped command with its exit code and output per verdict), or map a system's recurring judgments and their validation gaps (cog-ops-map).
